points: Diamond Rapids, the next Xeon generation, will be the last to include SGX
Support and security updates for SGX platforms continue into the early 2030s
Intel keeps investing in TDX Connect (trusted I/O), post-quantum cryptography and better attestation
take: Anyone running SGX enclaves needs a migration plan to VM-level TDX; Intel will support existing SGX platforms only into the early 2030s.
title: Intel: Diamond Rapids is the last Xeon with SGX enclaves
